errorCodes.meaning: No process supervisor was detected, so a graceful exit would not be followed by a restart — it would just stop the maintainer. Refused. Configure a supervisor (or set the maintainer's explicit opt-in) and retry.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

drainTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the maintainer will drain in-flight work before exiting, so a caller knows the expected downtime window.

supervisor.description: The process supervisor that will bring the maintainer back up, detected by the maintainer. An opaque maintainer-defined label — the framework does not enumerate it (e.g. `systemd`, `kubernetes`, or an explicit operator opt-in). A maintainer that detects no supervisor MUST refuse (see errorCodes) rather than exit unsupervised.

schema.description: Request a graceful restart so a process supervisor brings the maintainer back up with restart-gated configuration applied. Takes no parameters.
schema.title: Config Restart — payload
